d: Honey-blonde, medium-length hair with voluminous, wavy curls and a side-swept fringe. Golden-yellow eyes with a focused, neutral expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender, petite build wearing a light blue and cream-colored ruffled sleeveless dress with a matching light blue bow at the chest. A small blue spherical pouch with gold accents hangs from a thin strap around the waist, and a small white flower hairclip is tucked into the hair.
